description: Follows a spec for the signed-in person, or stops following it. Give the spec's id, and on as false to stop. A person who follows a spec sees its new versions on their Following page; the answer gives its address. Which specs a person follows is shown to nobody else. This tool needs sign-in. Ask the person before you call it.

on.description: True to follow, false to stop following. True when left out.

name: follow_spec
title: Follow a spec
